settings.label: Light or dark
settings.description: System follows the system preference; Automatic switches to light at sunrise and to dark at sunset where you are

settings.label: Apply to apps
settings.description: Also switches GTK and Qt apps, browsers (through the XDG portal) and the icon theme between light and dark

settings.label: Latitude
settings.description: For Automatic. Empty = from the system time zone

settings.label: Longitude
settings.description: For Automatic. Empty = from the system time zone

settings.label: Accent colour
settings.description: Used everywhere: selection, sliders, focus rings, window borders. Empty = Bifrost default (the theme's accent)

settings.label: Text and icons (light mode)
settings.description: Shell text and monochrome icons, including the top panel. Empty uses the theme colour.

settings.label: Text and icons (dark mode)
settings.description: Shell text and monochrome icons, including the top panel. Empty uses the theme colour.

settings.label: Density
settings.description: Compact = tighter panels, rows and spacing everywhere; Spacious = more air. Applies to the bar, dock, menus, popups and Settings

settings.label: Corner radius
settings.description: Scales every radius in the theme

settings.label: Bifrost prism
settings.description: Refraction on hover, selection and active items. 0 = off, 1 = standard, 3 = strong
